items.stem: An investigator wants to change a study's eligibility criteria to enrol faster. Before implementing the change, the investigator must usually:

options.text: Obtain IRB approval of the protocol amendment first
options.rationale: Correct: substantive protocol changes require prospective IRB approval.

options.text: Implement immediately and inform the IRB next year
options.rationale: Substantive changes require approval before implementation.

options.text: Ask the study sponsor's marketing team
options.rationale: Marketing has no role in protocol approval.

options.text: Change it only if no one notices
options.rationale: Compliance is not optional based on detection.

items.explanation: Correct: substantive protocol changes require prospective IRB approval.

items.stem: A procedure performed solely for research purposes is billed to the participant's insurer. This most likely indicates a problem with:

options.text: The study's coverage analysis and research billing
options.rationale: Correct: research-only procedures generally should not be billed to insurers; this is a billing-compliance issue.
Font size is unrelated to billing compliance.
The meeting schedule does not cause mis-billing.
Parking is irrelevant to the billing error.

items.explanation: Correct: research-only procedures generally should not be billed to insurers; this is a billing-compliance issue.

items.stem: Which TWO elements must a valid informed-consent process include? (Select TWO)

options.text: A description of the study's risks and benefits
options.rationale: Correct: risks and benefits are required consent elements.

options.text: A statement that participation is voluntary
options.rationale: Correct: voluntariness is a required element of consent.

options.text: A guarantee the study will succeed
options.rationale: No study can be guaranteed; such a claim is improper.
Salary is not a required consent element.

options.text: A requirement to waive all legal rights
options.rationale: Consent cannot require waiving legal rights.

items.explanation: Correct: risks and benefits are required consent elements. Correct: voluntariness is a required element of consent.
